description: This file contains test cases for browser type functionalities in Playwright, including checks for executable path, browser name, and error handling during connection attempts with non-Chromium browsers.

methods.name: browserType.executablePath should work
methods.description: Test that the executable path for a browser type exists and is valid.

methods.name: browserType.name should work
methods.description: Test that the browser type's name matches the expected browser name.

methods.name: should throw when trying to connect with not-chromium
methods.description: Test that connecting over CDP throws an error if the browser is not Chromium.

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^  const error = await browserType.connectOverCDP({ endpointURL: 'ws:\/\/foo' }).catch(e => e);$/
